## Setup 

```{r setup, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(CRP)
library(forestploter) # for forest plots
library(grid)
library(scales)
library(gt)

source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")

tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
```

### Get data

```{r}
# Get extended metadata rows for primary and key secondary endpoints
# Based on data extracted in 30_hierarchical_testing.Rmd
th_reg <- readRDS("50_output_db/outputs/summary_primary_key_secondary_analyses.rds")

# Get treatment column names
dexa_col <- names(th_reg)[th_reg[, grepl("^[Dd]exa", names(th_reg))]]
plac_col <- names(th_reg)[th_reg[, grepl("^[Pp]lacebo", names(th_reg))]]

# Make column with spaces where forest plot shall appear
th_reg[, plot := paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " ")]

# Format
th_reg[, Visit := paste("Day", visit)]

# Mark primary endpoint
th_reg[endpoint_level == "Primary", Visit := paste0(Visit, "*")]

# Format p-value
th_reg[`p-value`== "Not tested", `p-value` := "-"]
```

## Make forest plots

### General settings for forest plot

```{r}
# Set background to white and summary diamond to black
tm <- forest_theme(core = list(bg_params = list(fill = c("white"))),
                   vertline_lty = "dotted")
```


### Summary forest plot for primary and key secondary continuous endpoints

```{r}
# Get data rows for continuous endpoints
cont_dt <- th_reg[outcome_type == "cont"]

# Select columns for figure
cont_cols <- c("variable_label" ,"Visit", dexa_col, plac_col, "plot", "Effect", "p-value")
cont_pdat <- cont_dt[, .SD, .SDcols = cont_cols]

# Set column names
setnames(cont_pdat, 
         c("variable_label", "Effect",          "plot"),
         c("Outcome",        "Effect (95% CI)", " "))

# Format outcome names
cont_pdat[, Outcome := gsub("~", " ", Outcome, fixed = TRUE)]
cont_pdat[, Outcome := gsub("Visual-Analogue Scale", "VAS", Outcome, fixed = TRUE)]
cont_pdat[, Outcome := trimws(Outcome)]
cont_pdat
```

Define x-axis limits for forest plot based on confidence interval range
```{r}
# Lower limit for x-axis
ci_min <- cont_dt[, min(lower.CL, na.rm = TRUE)]
xmin <- pmin(0, 5 * floor(ci_min / 5))

# Upper limit for x-axis
ci_max <- cont_dt[, max(upper.CL, na.rm = TRUE)]
xmax <- pmax(0, 5 * ceiling(ci_max / 5))
  
# X-axis limits for plot
xlims <- c(xmin, xmax)

# Select appropriate x-axis ticks with the range of xlims
xticks <- pretty(xlims, n = 6)
xticks <- xticks[xticks >= xlims[1] & xticks <= xlims[2]]
```

Make forest plot using `forestploter::forest`:
```{r}
# Initiate forestplot:
cont_p <- forest(data      = cont_pdat,
                 theme     = tm,
                 est       = cont_dt[, estimate],
                 lower     = cont_dt[, lower.CL],
                 upper     = cont_dt[, upper.CL],
                 xlim      = xlims,
                 ticks_at  = xticks,
                 ci_column = 5)
# Adjust appearance of plot:
cont_p <- insert_text(cont_p, 
                      text = "Est. Mean (95% CI)", # additional header over Dexa/Placebo
                      part = "header", 
                      row  = 1,
                      col  = 3:4,
                      gp   = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
cont_p <- add_border(cont_p, # h-line over Dexa Plac no. subjects
                     part = "header", 
                     row  = 1,
                     col  = 3:4,
                     gp   = gpar(lwd = .5))
cont_p <- add_border(cont_p, # hline below header
                     part = "header", 
                     row  = 2,
                     gp   = gpar(lwd = .5))
cont_p <- edit_plot(cont_p, # right-align p-value column
                    col   = 7, 
                    which = "text", 
                    hjust = unit(1, "npc"), 
                    x     = unit(0.9, "npc"))
```

```{r fig.width=get_wh(cont_p)["width"], fig.height=get_wh(cont_p)["height"]}
cont_p
```


### Summary forest plot for key secondary binary endpoints

```{r}
# Get data for binary endpoints
bin_dt <- th_reg[outcome_type == "binary"]

# Select columns for figure
bincols <- c("oc_kind_label", "Visit", dexa_col, plac_col, "plot", 
              "Effect", "p-value")
bin_pdata <- bin_dt[, .SD, .SDcols = bincols]

# Set column names
setnames(bin_pdata, 
         c("oc_kind_label", "Effect",      "plot"), 
         c("Outcome",       "OR (95% CI)", " "))

# Format Outcome variables
bin_pdata[Outcome == "Responder", Outcome := paste0(Outcome,"†")]
bin_pdata[Outcome == "Remission", Outcome := paste0(Outcome, "‡")]
bin_pdata[Outcome == "Sustained response", Outcome := paste0(Outcome,"§")]
bin_pdata
```

Make x-axis limits and ticks based on confidence limit range
```{r}
# X-axis limits based on CI limits and with additional margin
ci_range <- range(c(bin_dt[, lower.CL], bin_dt[, upper.CL]), na.rm = TRUE)
xlims <- c(min(ci_range[1], 1) * 0.8, 
           min(ci_range[2], 400) * 1.25) 

# Select appropriate tick marks within xlims range
xticks <- scales::breaks_log(n = 6, base = 2)(xlims)
xticks <- c(1, xticks[xticks >= xlims[1] & xticks <= xlims[2]])
```

Make forest plot using forestploter::forest:
```{r}
# Initiate forest plot:
bin_p <- forest(data      = bin_pdata,
                theme     = tm,
                est       = bin_dt[, estimate],
                lower     = bin_dt[, lower.CL],
                upper     = bin_dt[, upper.CL],
                ref_line  = 1,
                x_trans   = "log",
                xlim      = xlims, 
                ticks_at  = xticks,
                ci_column = 5)
# Adjust appearance of plot:
bin_p <- insert_text(bin_p, 
                     text = "Cases / N", # additional header above Dexa/Placebo cols
                     part = "header", 
                     row  = 1,
                     col  = 3:4,
                     gp   = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
bin_p <- add_border(bin_p, # h-line over Dexa Plac no. subjects
                    part  = "header", 
                    row   = 1,
                    col   = 3:4,
                    gp    = gpar(lwd = .5))
bin_p <- add_border(bin_p, # hline below header
                    part  = "header", 
                    row   = 2,
                    gp    = gpar(lwd = .5))
bin_p <- edit_plot(bin_p, # right-align p-value column
                   col    = 7, 
                   which  = "text", 
                   hjust  = unit(1, "npc"), 
                   x      = unit(0.9, "npc"))
```

```{r fig.width=get_wh(bin_p)["width"], fig.height=get_wh(bin_p)["height"]}
# Return the plot:
bin_p
```


## Save figures

Function that expands a forestplot to a specified same width
```{r}
#' Expand a forest plot to a specified width
#'
#' Increases the width of a forestploter plot so it matches a given total
#' width. The extra space is distributed equally across all columns except
#' the first. Plots that are already at least as wide as `width` are
#' returned unchanged. A warning is flagged if the plot is already wider than 
#' `width`.
#'
#' @param p A forest plot created with [forestploter::forest()].
#' @param width Target total width in inches.
#'
#' @return The forest plot `p` with adjusted column widths.
expand_to_width <- function(p, width) {
  wh <- get_wh(p, unit = "in")
  extra <- width - wh["width"]
  if (extra < 0){
    warning("Plot is wider than target width.")
  }
  if (extra > 0) {
    n <- length(p$widths)
    p$widths[-1] <- p$widths[-1] + unit(extra / (n - 1), "in")
  }
  p
}
```

Expand figures to the width of the forest plot with max width:
```{r}
# Width of forestplot with binary endpoints
p_wh_bin <- get_wh(bin_p)

# Width of forestplot with continuous endpoints
p_wh_cont <- get_wh(cont_p)

# Target width of both plots
p_w <- max(p_wh_bin["width"], p_wh_cont["width"])

# Expand plots to target width
cont_p <- expand_to_width(cont_p, p_w)
bin_p  <- expand_to_width(bin_p, p_w)
```

Save summary of key secondary continuous endpoints:
```{r}
# Metadata row for continuous endpoints:
regi_cont <- tlf_reg[file_stem == "compare_effects_primary_key_secondary_cont"]

# Add source tables to cross-reference library:
add_to_crossref(endpoint_id = regi_cont[, endpoint_id],
                key         = cont_dt[, paste(variable_label, "at Day", visit)],
                source      = cont_dt[, endpoint_id])

# Make file paths:
png_path_cont <- regi_cont[, file.path(folder, paste0(file_stem, ".png"))]
pdf_path_cont <- regi_cont[, file.path(folder, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"))]

# Save figures:
cowplot::ggsave2(filename = png_path_cont, cont_p, width = p_w, height = p_wh_cont["height"])
cowplot::ggsave2(filename = pdf_path_cont, cont_p, width = p_w, height = p_wh_cont["height"])
```

Save summary of key secondary binary endpoints
```{r}
# Metadata row for binary endpoints:
regi_bin <- tlf_reg[file_stem == "compare_effects_key_secondary_binary"]

# Add source tables to cross-reference library:
add_to_crossref(endpoint_id = regi_bin[, endpoint_id],
                key         = bin_dt[, paste(oc_kind_label, "at Day", visit)],
                source      = bin_dt[, endpoint_id])

# Make file paths:
png_path_bin <- regi_bin[, file.path(folder, paste0(file_stem, ".png"))]
pdf_path_bin <- regi_bin[, file.path(folder, paste0(file_stem, ".pdf"))]

# Save figures:
cowplot::ggsave2(filename = png_path_bin, bin_p, width = p_w, height = p_wh_bin["height"])
cowplot::ggsave2(filename = pdf_path_bin, bin_p, width = p_w, height = p_wh_bin["height"])
```


## Safety outcomes

```{r, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
tlf_reg[, .N, .(chapter, transformation, outcome_var)]
outc_var <- outc_vars[1]
```


### SAPS, GTI, YMRS, and C-SSRS

Get data for SAPS, GTI, YMRS, and C-SSRS:
```{r}
# Get metadata for vital sign outcomes:
outc_vars <- c("saps_total", "gti_total", "ymrs_total", 
               "cssrs_suicide_thoughts", "cssrs_ideation")
stopifnot(tlf_reg[, all(outc_vars %in% unique(outcome_var))])
tab <- tlf_reg[outcome_var %in% outc_vars &
                 (analysis == "logistic" | outcome_kind == "chgbl") &
                 role == "Primary" &
                 tlf_type == "table", 
               .(outcome_var, outcome_label, visit, endpoint_id, analysis,
                 variable_label)]
tab[, row_order := seq_len(.N)]

# Extract data:
d1 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i) { # i <- 1
  regi <- tlf_reg[endpoint_id == tab[i, endpoint_id]]
  res <- get_dt_table(regi)
  res2 <- if(tab[i, analysis %in% "logistic"]) {
    res[Visit == paste("Day", tab[i, visit]), 
        .(Treatment, `Est. Mean (95% CI)` = `Est. Prob (95% CI)`, 
          `Effect (95% CI)` = `OR (95% CI)`, estimate = odds.ratio, 
          lower.CL = lwr.lrt, upper.CL = upr.lrt, `p-value`, trt)] 
  } else { 
    res[Visit == paste("Day", tab[i, visit]), 
        .(Treatment, `Est. Mean (95% CI)`, `Effect (95% CI)`, estimate, 
          lower.CL, upper.CL, `p-value`, trt)]
  }
  cbind(tab[i], res2)
}) |> rbindlist()

# Get treatment levels:
trt_levs <- get_trt_levs(d1)
ref_trt_lev <- trt_levs["reference"] |> unname()
dexa_trt_lev <- trt_levs["active"] |> unname()
trt_levs <- c(dexa_trt_lev, ref_trt_lev)

# Estimated means data:
d_emm <- dcast(d1, outcome_var + visit ~ Treatment, value.var = "Est. Mean (95% CI)")

# Treatment effect data:
d_eff <- d1[grepl("[Dd]exa", Treatment)]

# All data:
.d <- merge(d_emm, d_eff, by = c("outcome_var", "visit"))[order(row_order)]
.d[, Visit := paste("Day", visit)]

# Conditional outcome formatting:
.d[, Outcome := variable_label]
.d[, Outcome := gsub(" - Suicidal", "", Outcome)]
.d[analysis == "logistic", Outcome := paste0(Outcome, "*")]
```


Safety rating scales summary `gt` table:
```{r}
# Get data:
tab_cols <- c("Outcome", "Visit", dexa_trt_lev, ref_trt_lev, 
                 "Effect (95% CI)", "p-value", "endpoint_id")
.dd <- .d[, .SD, .SDcols = tab_cols]
.dd[, `Source table` := paste0("[-@sec-", endpoint_id, "]")]
.dd[, endpoint_id := NULL]

# Make gt-table:
gt_tab <- gt(.dd) |> 
  tab_spanner(label = "Est. Means (95% CI)", columns = trt_levs) |>
  set_gt_style()  |>
  # Include border line under spanner columns
  tab_options(
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "#333333",
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1)
  ) |> 
  # Left align first column
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = list(
      cells_body(columns = "Outcome"),
      cells_column_labels(columns = "Outcome")
    )
  )

# Make footers:
table_footers <- get_footers()

# Scales:
sc_foot <- sapply(seq_len(.d[, .N]), function(i) { # i <- 1
  outc <- .d[i, variable_label]
  table_footers[sapply(key, grepl, x = outc), footer][1]
}) |> unique()

# Abbreviations:
key_list <- c("Est. Mean", "CI", "Effect")
abbrev_foot <- sapply(key_list, function(k) {
  table_footers[key == k, footer]
}, USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# Add footers to gt-table:
foot_list <- list(
  paste0(paste(sc_foot, collapse = ", "), "."),
  paste0(paste(abbrev_foot, collapse = ", "), "."),
  table_footers[type == "qualifier" & key == "SAS", footer],
  paste0("*: Analysis is a logisitic regression model presented as estimated", 
         " probabilities and Odds Ratio for Dexamethasone / Placebo."))

gt_tab <- add_footer_lines_to_gt(gt_tab, footer_list = foot_list)
gt_tab
```

Save `gt` table
```{r}
save_gt_table(gt_tab,
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "safety_rating_scales_overview"],
              verbose = TRUE)
```


### Vital signs

Get data for vital signs:
```{r}
# Get metadata for vital sign outcomes:
outc_vars <- tlf_reg[chapter == "vital signs", unique(outcome_var)]
tab <- tlf_reg[outcome_var %in% outc_vars &
                 role == "Primary" &
                 tlf_type == "table", 
                .(outcome_var, outcome_label, visit, endpoint_id, analysis)]
tab[, row_order := seq_len(.N)]

# Extract data:
d1 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i) { # i <- 1
  regi <- tlf_reg[endpoint_id == tab[i, endpoint_id]]
  res <- get_dt_table(regi)
  res <- res[Visit == paste("Day", tab[i, visit]), 
             .(Treatment, `Est. Mean (95% CI)`, `Effect (95% CI)`, estimate, 
               lower.CL, upper.CL, `p-value`, trt)]
  cbind(tab[i], res)
}) |> rbindlist()

# Get treatment levels:
trt_levs <- get_trt_levs(d1)
ref_trt_lev <- trt_levs["reference"] |> unname()
dexa_trt_lev <- trt_levs["active"] |> unname()
trt_levs <- c(dexa_trt_lev, ref_trt_lev)

# Estimated means data:
d_emm <- dcast(d1, outcome_var  ~ Treatment, value.var = "Est. Mean (95% CI)")

# Treatment effect data:
# eff_cols <- c("outcome_var", "outcome_label", "Effect (95% CI)", "estimate", 
#               "lower.CL", "upper.CL", "p-value", "row_order", "endpoint_id")

# All plotting data:
```

```{r vital_signs_forest_plot, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# fig.width=get_wh(pvital)["width"], fig.height=get_wh(pvital)["height"]
# Make vital signs forest plot:

# # Make column with spaces where forest plot shall appear
# d_emm[, plot := paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " ")]

# columns for the forest plot:
forest_cols <- c("outcome_label", "Visit", dexa_trt_lev, ref_trt_lev, "plot", 
                 "Effect (95% CI)", "p-value")
dforest <- .d[, .SD, .SDcols = forest_cols]
setnames(dforest, 
         c("outcome_label", "plot"), 
         c("Vital sign",    " "))

# Initiate forestplot:
pvital <- forest(data      = dforest,
                 theme     = tm,
                 est       = .d[, estimate],
                 lower     = .d[, lower.CL],
                 upper     = .d[, upper.CL],
                 xlim      = c(-4, 4),
                 # ticks_at  = xticks,
                 ci_column = 5)
# Adjust appearance of plot:
pvital <- insert_text(pvital, 
                      text = "Est. Mean (95% CI)", # additional header over Dexa/Placebo
                      part = "header", 
                      row  = 1,
                      col  = which(names(dforest) %in% trt_levs),
                      gp   = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
pvital <- add_border(pvital, # h-line over Dexa Plac no. subjects
                     part = "header", 
                     row  = 1,
                     col  = which(names(dforest) %in% trt_levs),
                     gp   = gpar(lwd = .5))
pvital <- add_border(pvital, # hline below header
                     part = "header", 
                     row  = 2,
                     gp   = gpar(lwd = .5))
pvital <- edit_plot(pvital, # right-align p-value column
                    col   = which(names(dforest) == "p-value"), 
                    which = "text", 
                    hjust = unit(1, "npc"), 
                    x     = unit(0.9, "npc"))
pvital
```

Get data for biochemistry:
```{r}
# Get metadata for biochemistry outcomes:
outc_vars <- tlf_reg[chapter == "biochemistry", unique(outcome_var)]
tab <- tlf_reg[outcome_var %in% outc_vars &
                 role == "Primary" &
                 tlf_type == "table", 
                .(outcome_var, outcome_label, visit, endpoint_id, analysis,
                  transformation)]
tab[, row_order := seq_len(.N)]

# Extract data:
d1 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i) { # i <- 15
  regi <- tlf_reg[endpoint_id == tab[i, endpoint_id]]
  res <- get_dt_table(regi)
  res2 <- if(tab[i, analysis %in% "logistic"]) {
    res[Visit == paste("Day", tab[i, visit]), 
        .(Treatment, `Est. Mean (95% CI)` = `Est. Prob (95% CI)`, 
          `Effect (95% CI)` = `OR (95% CI)`, estimate = odds.ratio, 
          lower.CL = lwr.lrt, upper.CL = upr.lrt, `p-value`, trt)] 
  } else { 
    res[Visit == paste("Day", tab[i, visit]), 
        .(Treatment, `Est. Mean (95% CI)`, `Effect (95% CI)`, estimate, 
          lower.CL, upper.CL, `p-value`, trt)]
  }
  cbind(tab[i], res2)
}) |> rbindlist()


# Get treatment levels:
trt_levs <- get_trt_levs(d1)
ref_trt_lev <- trt_levs["reference"] |> unname()
dexa_trt_lev <- trt_levs["active"] |> unname()
trt_levs <- c(dexa_trt_lev, ref_trt_lev)
```

```{r}
}, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
abbrev_foot <- gsub("difference", "ratio", abbrev_foot)
abbrev_foot <- gsub("-", "/", abbrev_foot)

# Add footers to gt-table:
foot_list <- list(
  scale = paste0(paste(sc_foot, collapse = ", "), "."),
  table_footers[type == "qualifier" & key == "SAS", footer],
  abbrev = paste0(paste(abbrev_foot, collapse = ", "), "."),
  "*: Effect is an estimated treatment difference for Dexamethasone - Placebo",
  paste0("§: Analysis is a logisitic regression model presented as estimated", 
         " probabilities and Odds Ratio for Dexamethasone / Placebo."))
gt_tab <- add_footer_lines_to_gt(gt_tab, footer_list = foot_list)
gt_tab
```

Save `gt` table
```{r}
save_gt_table(gt_tab,
              regi = tlf_reg[file_stem == "biochemistry_overview"],
              verbose = TRUE)
```
